That which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action is called Instrument or करण कारक।

Terms: कारक-सम्प्रदान

In conjunction with the words साधु 'good' and निपुण 'skilfull' when they denote respect, the 7th case-affix is used, provided that the word प्रति is not used.

Terms: विभक्ति-7

सध is substituted for सह in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when माद and स्थ follow.

Terms: Some Substitution
